requestedIntent: Preserve ACEF Full and Guarded risk controls while removing duplicate per-story assurance passes through a versioned four-actor lifecycle, deterministic story close, conditional adjudication, and bounded repair.

docs: CHANGELOG.md#Full story lifecycle v3.2 recovery candidate

limitations: Existing Full active runs without fullFlowContract remain six-actor-v2; v3 is not an in-place migration after lifecycle evidence exists.
The deterministic gate validates typed local artifacts, Git ancestry, hashes, and runner proof; it does not defeat a malicious actor able to forge the repository and every local record.
A Product Outcome Verifier remains conditional for user/runtime surfaces; the backend P0 candidate uses the frozen withheld behavioral oracle plus the mandatory Epic Process Judge.
The capability is enforced in this source tree but is not installed in target repositories until their ACEF tools, skills, schemas, and hooks are refreshed.

The v3 P0 manifest is bound to implementation commit 23b58de. Its first preregistered candidate failed automated closeout, the blind product judgment, and cost budgets, so the capability remains enforced rather than proven or authorized beyond controlled canaries.

The failed v3 P0 artifacts remain immutable. V3.1 repaired real-environment preflight, story-tree scope, reviewer completion, and measurement ceilings, but its P0 still failed process closeout after exhausting 21 actor invocations; its blind Judge was mechanically blocked because packet validation omitted frozen testPaths.

V3.2 accepts frozen testPaths as blinded product artifacts, raises only the actor hard cap to the observed 25-invocation recovery envelope, renders acceptance criteria explicitly, and excludes readiness notes from bound close packages.

The v3.2 P0 admitted and completed blind judgment but failed automated, process, product, broad-closeout, and harness-wait gates. It exposed a namespaced-call ATDD authenticity false negative and a contradictory frozen Story 2 ATDD contract, so the capability remains enforced rather than proven.

The v3.3 and v3.4 P0 attempts are immutable automated and blind failures. V3.5 preparation addresses the measured legacy-ledger, durability-dosing, repair-test continuity, reviewer-result, retry-topology, and generic MySQL oracle gaps, but no separately frozen v3.5 scored result exists. Maturity remains enforced rather than proven.
